findings.correction: the common game-promotional line: *Awaiting a new hero!*
findings.current: the common game-promotional line: *A new hero awaits!*
findings.defect: The omitted subject waits for a new hero; the English makes the hero the one who waits.
findings.rationale: 기다린다 takes 새로운 영웅 as object, the usual ‘we/the world await a new hero’ ad line, not ‘a new hero awaits (something)’.
findings.source: ‘새로운 영웅을 기다린다!’라는 흔한 게임 홍보 멘트

findings.correction:
“I think he's the same age as me.”

“…Hang in there.”
findings.current:
“I think he's the same age as me.”

“…”

“Hang in there.”
findings.defect: One Jinho line is split into two quoted turns, so alternating dialogue makes ‘Hang in there’ look like Taekyung’s.
findings.rationale: 힘내라 is Jinho’s beat after the same-age line; a separate “…” turn reverses who is consoling whom.

findings.correction:
“You look like you've just been slapped.”

“…You must be mistaken.”
findings.current:
“You look like you've just been slapped.”

“…”

“You must be mistaken.”
findings.defect: Taekyung’s denial is split into two quotes, so the second line can read as Wikyung’s.
findings.rationale: 잘못 보셨네요 is Taekyung rejecting the slapped-face reading; turn-taking makes Wikyung the one saying he is mistaken.

findings.correction: *Still, I'd piled up quite a bit.*
findings.current:
*Still, quite a crowd.*

I opened the Status Window and saw that I was about fifty short of the target value.
findings.defect: 모였다 is read as a crowd; the prior and next lines are about Fame toward the target.
findings.rationale: 그래도 contrasts family NPCs no longer raising 명성치; the Status Window check of being about 50 short only follows if the thought is about Fame, not the crowd already described.
findings.source:
태원진가 사람들로는 명성치가 오르지 않았다.
‘그래도 꽤 모였다.’
상태창을 열어 보니 목표 수치보다 50 정도가 부족했다.

findings.correction: I had already overwhelmed Lee Seogeun, a First Rate master.
findings.current: I had overwhelmed Lee Seogeun, an accomplished First Rate master.
findings.defect: 일찍이 is moved onto Lee Seogeun as ‘accomplished’ instead of marking that Taekyung had already overwhelmed him.
findings.rationale: 일찍이 modifies the past feat 압도했다; 일류 고수인 only identifies Lee Seogeun’s realm.

findings.correction: If I couldn't even believe in myself, I was Second Rate. No. I *had been* Second Rate.
findings.current:
Someone who couldn't even believe in himself was Second Rate.

No. He *had been* Second Rate.
findings.rationale: 나는 … 이류다 / 였었다 is Taekyung correcting his own present-tense claim, not a general ‘he’.
findings.source: 스스로도 못 믿는 나는 이류다. 아니, 였었다.

findings.rationale: The line is crude self-reproach at not trusting himself; ‘idiot’ sanitizes the register.

findings.current: “Ahh. Thank you. Gà bù lái sī yóu.”
findings.defect: Korean parroting of English ‘God bless you’ is recast as Chinese pinyin.
findings.rationale: 갑부래수유 is the NPC repeating 갓 블레스 유 by ear, not Chinese dialogue the series romanizes with tone marks.

findings.defect: The named reading is 믿을 신 (believe), which the tea-writing advice then uses.
findings.rationale: 진위경’s gloss is 너 자신을 믿으란 소리 and 믿는 것부터 시작; ‘Faith?’ shifts the character toward a different English noun.

findings.correction: Keep a sect-style name if needed, but footnote that the source supplies 三道問 (question), not 門.
findings.current:
“Guo of the Three Paths Sect presents his respects.”[^1]

[^1]: “Three Paths Sect” is a literal rendering of the sect’s name.
findings.defect: The footnote calls ‘Sect’ a literal rendering while the given graph is 問, not 門.
findings.rationale: First-use notes must match the characters on the page; 問 is not a literal ‘Sect’.

summary: Several speaker, subject, and mechanism errors change who speaks, what the promo line means, what Taekyung is counting, and how the God-bless-you beat works.
